slug: 2025-02-14 Sierra Leone Launches National Instant Payment System

facts.fact: Afrimoney and Orange Money operate mobile money in Sierra Leone, and central bank data show 8.2 million mobile money accounts at 31 December 2023.
Sierra Leone launched real-time transfers between mobile money operators, banks, and mobile money and bank accounts on 13 February 2025, with seven banks and two mobile money providers connected.
The Bank of Sierra Leone's national instant payment switch connects mobile money accounts and bank accounts, launched 13 February 2025.
